evidences.caption: FILE - In this Feb. 19, 2016 file photo, Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump speaks during a campaign stop in North Charleston, S.C. Then-candidate Trump gave a stump speech in which he railed against American jobs moving to Mexico: We lose our jobs, we close our factories, Mexico gets all of the work, he said. We get nothing. That same day a law firm in Mexico City quietly filed for trademarks that would authorize the Trump brand to set up shop in a country with which he has sparred over trade, migration and the planned border wall. (AP Photo/Matt Rourke, File)
